card.name: Punctuation before alpha-blocker drug names
card.fires_on: Small linking marks or words such as a colon, "such as", "e.g.,", "including" or "other" right after an alpha-blocker class name. The next word is expected to be a specific alpha-blocker like alfuzosin, phentolamine or tamsulosin.

modes.label: Colon after class name
modes.description: A colon after an alpha-1 adrenoreceptor antagonist heading in an interaction table, before alfuzosin.
modes.example: mg twice daily. Other Agents Alpha 1-adrenoreceptor antagonist<<:>> alfuzosin ↑ alfuzos

modes.label: Linking words before examples
modes.description: "such as", "including" or "e.g.," after alpha-blocker class terms, introducing named drugs.
modes.example: to increased concentrations of metoprolol. Alpha-Adrenergic Agents Antihypertensive effect of alpha-adrenergic blockers such<< as>> guanethidine, betanidine

card.writes: It seems to prepare the model to name a specific alpha-blocker drug next, though the listed tokens are not informative.
card.plain: It lights up on the small link right after "alpha blocker" that leads into a named drug like alfuzosin or phentolamine.
